name: Defiant Cure
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level alchemist 5, cleric/oracle 5, inquisitor 5, druid 5, ranger 4, shaman 5, witch 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 round/2 levels
Saving Throw Fort negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as a combination of remove disease and neutralize poison. Except that if the disease or poison are not removed, you can continue to attempt to remove it each round. Once the poison or disease is removed, this spell ends.
